senses.definition: In Latin, the shortening of an etymologically long final vowel, in a two-syllable word where the first vowel is also short. It tended to persist in uninflected words like bene, but was levelled out in favour of inflectional regularity in other words.
A poetic meter consisting of lines with four iambic feet each, meaning the even syllable is dominant.
A commune and village in Olt County, Romania.
